questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed limit.
The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
You must not travel below the speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed limit under ideal conditions is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs tell you the maximum speed allowed on that road. You can drive slower than the posted limit based on road conditions, but you cannot drive faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards. Orange signs are used in construction or maintenance areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate road hazards. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downgrade ahead. The hill may also have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services ahead, such as rest areas, food, gas, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: Round signs mark railroad crossings. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks to warn drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. Slow down when you see wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mark work zones. Stay alert and expect unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns of a flagger ahead whose directions you must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign means you must follow the rule. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Start slowing down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Come to a complete stop at the marked line or before the crosswalk. Look for other vehicles and pedestrians. If the path is clear, you may proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to an intersection ahead so you can prepare to turn or watch for traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a full stop and look in all directions for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are combining into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Some warning signs have a bright yellow-green background. These signs warn of upcoming hazards like sharp curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks where pedestrians cross the road. Watch for people crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to potential hazards. This sign tells you a side road will intersect the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to an abrupt change in road direction. Slow down and be ready to turn sharply.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An orange triangle on the back of a vehicle warns that it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. The triangle is solid orange during the day and appears as a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic will merge from the right. Be prepared to make room for merging vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down, drive with caution, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted near schools to remind drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that traffic signals are ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed and drive with care.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end ahead. You must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to allow it to merge safely.
